cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The lift's broken. I've approved replacing our gym with the stairs; you may cancel the memberships.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we reconsider? We live eight floors up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Eight floors are approved as a complete workout. Excellent value: the equipment is already in the building.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do we carry the shopping up?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Weighted sessions are approved too. Buy little and often; each trip now does the groceries and the gym. We've eliminated a journey.

reason: Turn objections into a revised cheaper routine rather than generic cheer, with B shopping question causing combined errands and exercise under A approval.
